recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量豐富，以早幼粒細胞（promyelocyte）與骨髓細胞等顆粒球前驅細胞占多數，但仍一路成熟到桿狀與分節嗜中性球，芽細胞並未明顯成片，這種「同步左移但會成熟」的樣貌符合化療或抑制後恢復中的骨髓。
features: Hypercellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors
Left shift with numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes (round to oval nuclei, granular cytoplasm, some with paranuclear hof)
Continued maturation to metamyelocytes, band and segmented neutrophils
Occasional larger cells with basophilic cytoplasm; no sheet of agranular blasts
Scattered erythroid precursors and lymphocytes; no dysplastic features evident at this power
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a hypercellular specimen with marked granulocytic predominance and a left shift, with numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes showing granular cytoplasm and paranuclear hofs. Orderly maturation continues through metamyelocytes, bands, and segmented neutrophils, and blasts do not form sheets. Erythroid precursors and lymphocytes are present in lesser numbers. Findings are consistent with regenerating (recovering) marrow with a synchronous wave of granulocytic maturation, such as after chemotherapy or G-CSF; a formal blast count and clinical correlation are needed to exclude residual leukemia.

ddx.vs: APL shows a monotonous population of abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei, Auer rod bundles and arrested maturation, whereas recovering marrow shows normal promyelocytes maturing to neutrophils.
Residual AML shows increased agranular blasts (often aberrant immunophenotype on flow), rather than a maturing wave of granulated precursors.
CML shows a myelocyte peak with basophilia, eosinophilia and small hypolobated megakaryocytes and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
